profile.name: Rakesh Kumar
profile.availability: Open to Software Engineer / Full-Stack Developer opportunities

engineeringPhilosophy.approach: Rakesh builds systems that prove they work rather than relying on guesses or unverified claims. His engineering focuses on correctness, empirical benchmarking, and deterministic architecture.
engineeringPhilosophy.signatureProjects: TRACE (achieving 89.5% accuracy via adversarial critique loop), CHRONOS (finding 46-session schedule in 46 nodes with 0 backtracks), and SyncPad (conflict-free CRDT synchronization and sandboxed WASM execution).

highlights: Built a role-aware employee management system that replaced spreadsheet-based tracking and supported employee, manager, and admin workflows.
Secured CRUD REST APIs for employee, department, and role modules with JWT authentication, RBAC middleware, and request validation; used Postman to test operations and validate responses.

primaryProjects.name: TRACE
primaryProjects.expandedName: TRACE — Telemetry Root-Cause Autonomous Critique Engine

verifiedMetrics.rootCauseAccuracy: 89.5% accuracy vs 73.7% for naive single-prompt LLM baseline
verifiedMetrics.benchmarkDataset: 19 synthetic incidents with hidden root causes
verifiedMetrics.keyFeature: Deterministic scoring and LLM critique loop with temporal/causal telemetry correlation and trend-comparison checks

highlights: Achieved 89.5% root-cause accuracy across 19 synthetic incidents with hidden root causes, versus a 73.7% single-prompt LLM baseline, using deterministic scoring and an LLM critique loop.

Correlated logs, metrics, traces, and deployment events through temporal and causal evidence; added a deterministic trend-comparison check after failure-case analysis exposed an incorrect memory-leak attribution.
primaryProjects.description: An incident root-cause engine that achieved 89.5% accuracy across 19 synthetic incidents with hidden root causes (16 percentage points above a single-prompt LLM baseline) using deterministic scoring, an LLM critique loop, and temporal/causal telemetry correlation.
primaryProjects.motivation: Built to test whether an AI system can genuinely investigate unknown production incidents rather than generating convincing guesses, proving 89.5% accuracy via adversarial critique loops.

primaryProjects.name: CHRONOS
primaryProjects.tagline: MRV/LCV Constraint Solver with Live Search Visualization

verifiedMetrics.benchmarkComparison: MRV/LCV found a valid 46-session schedule in 46 search nodes with zero backtracks; chronological search hit the 10-million-backtrack limit without finding a solution on the same input.
verifiedMetrics.heuristics: MRV (Minimum Remaining Values) and LCV (Least Constraining Value)
verifiedMetrics.nlpExtraction: Natural-language scheduling requirement translation into structured constraints via Gemini API

highlights: Found a valid 46-session schedule in 46 search nodes with zero backtracks using MRV/LCV; chronological search hit the 10-million-backtrack limit without finding a solution on the same input.
Built a backtracking constraint solver with live D3.js search visualization and integrated the Gemini API to translate natural-language scheduling requirements into structured constraints.
primaryProjects.description: A timetable scheduling engine solving Constraint Satisfaction Problems (CSP) via backtracking search with MRV and LCV heuristics. Features a live D3.js search-tree visualizer showing chronological and MRV/LCV-guided search behaviour in real time.
primaryProjects.motivation: Built to solve complex timetable scheduling and demonstrate how MRV/LCV heuristic search finds a valid schedule in 46 nodes with zero backtracks.

primaryProjects.name: SyncPad
primaryProjects.tagline: CRDT Collaboration with Sandboxed In-Browser Execution
primaryProjects.category: CRDT Real-Time Engine • In-Browser WASM Runtime

verifiedMetrics.inBrowserExecution: Browser-based sandboxed execution with Web Workers (JS/TS via transpilation) and Pyodide WebAssembly (Python)
verifiedMetrics.networking: Standalone y-websocket relay deployed on Render for binary document synchronization

highlights: Enabled conflict-free concurrent editing with Yjs CRDT synchronization, live cursor sharing, and collaborator presence.
Implemented browser-based execution for JavaScript, TypeScript through transpilation, and Python using Web Workers and Pyodide WebAssembly, keeping execution off the main UI thread.
primaryProjects.description: A real-time collaborative code editor supporting concurrent multi-user editing with conflict-free Yjs CRDT synchronization, live cursor sharing, collaborator presence, and browser-based sandboxed execution for JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python.
primaryProjects.motivation: Built to provide seamless real-time collaborative editing with conflict-free Yjs CRDT convergence and secure in-browser code execution using WebAssembly.

primaryProjects.motivation: Built to automate production incident triage and postmortem generation with rock-solid architectural reliability, 236/236 unit tests, and real OAuth integrations.
